title: Decomposers and Nitrogen Fixers
summary: Microbes that recycle dead matter into compost, and Rhizobium bacteria that turn air into fertiliser.

ib.note: Nutrient cycles (the nitrogen cycle) follow in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye

objectives: I can explain the role of decomposers in recycling nutrients.
I can describe how nitrogen-fixing bacteria in root nodules help plants.
I can evaluate composting as a way of managing waste.
misconceptions: Dead things just disappear by themselves.
Plants take nitrogen straight from the air.
